v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: De Sion * véniet Dóminus omnípotens, ut salvum fáciat pópulum suum.
text.en: The Lord, the Almighty, * cometh out of Zion, to save his people.

text.la: Convértere, Dómine, * aliquántulum, et ne tardes veníre ad servos tuos.
text.en: Turn thee, O Lord, * at the last, and tarry not to come unto thy servants.

text.la: De Sion * véniet, qui regnatúrus est Dóminus, Emmánuel magnum nomen eius.
text.en: The Lord that shall rule * shall come forth from Zion, Emmanuel is his name, and his name is great.

text.la: Ecce Deus meus, * et honorábo eum: Deus patris mei, et exaltábo eum.
text.en: Behold, he is my God, * and I will glorify him: my father's God, and I will exalt him.

text.la: Dóminus * légifer noster, Dóminus Rex noster, ipse véniet, et salvábit nos.
text.en: The Lord our Law-giver, * the Lord our King, he cometh and will save us.

text.la: Veníte, et ascendámus ad montem Dómini, et ad domum Dei Iacob, et docébit nos vias suas, et ambulábimus in sémitis eius: quia de Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Ierúsalem.
text.en: Come and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob, and he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall come forth from Sion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Vigiláte * ánimo, in próximo est Dóminus Deus noster.
text.en: Let your soul watch, * the Lord our God is nigh at hand.

text.la: Aurem tuam, quǽsumus, Dómine, précibus nostris accómmoda: et mentis nostræ ténebras, grátia tuæ visitatiónis illústra:
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee, mercifully incline thine ears unto our prayers, and lighten the darkness of our minds by the grace of thy heavenly visitation.

office.title: Feria V infra Hebd III Adventus
